mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where GDP increases for two consecutive quarters, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a single month signals a tightening labor market, increasing wage pressures and reducing corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production by more than 1% in a single month signals a weakening supply side, leading to reduced economic output and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% in a single month signals a strengthening demand side, boosting economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI increases by more than 0.3% in a single month, it signals inflationary pressure during a tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary period with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls increase by more than 200,000 in a single month and the unemployment rate decreases by more than 0.2%, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month and UNRATE decreases > 0.2%
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP and a simultaneous increase in retail and food services sales signal strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both GDP and retail sales increase, the hypothesis is rejected.
